# BRC STAR (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED — Technical Knowledge Base

> BRC STAR is an Indian deep-tech electric mobility startup researching auxiliary mechanical kinetic energy recovery and closed-loop dual-battery switching architectures.

## Corporate Identity & Governance
- **Legal Entity**: BRC STAR (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED
- **Corporate Identification Number (CIN)**: U34100RJ2019OPC066948

- **Registered Headquarters**: 7SJM-A, Anupgarh, Ganganagar, Rajasthan 335701, India
- **Incubation & Recognition**: iStart Rajasthan (Government of Rajasthan) and DPIIT Startup India Recognized Startup

## Intellectual Property & Patent Status
- **Primary Filing**: Indian Patent Application No. 202511050655 (patent-pending, filed with the Indian Patent Office; not yet published or granted).
- **Title**: Closed-Loop Dual-Pack Kinetic Energy Recovery Architecture and Adaptive Alternator Control System for Electric Vehicles
- **International (PCT) Filing**: Status to be confirmed (no country-level foreign grant claimed).
- **Technology Readiness Level (TRL)**: TRL 3/4 (Stage 1 ACM Lab Bench; Dual-Pack Switcher Simulation; Vehicle CAD/CFD Concept).

## Core Technical Architecture: Self Volt
1. **Dual-Pack Sequential Topology**: Physically separates primary traction discharge (Pack A) from kinetic recovery capture (Pack B), designed to reduce thermal stress on active cells.
2. **Alternator Control Module (ACM)**: Variable-frequency active rectifier stage evaluated at Stage 1 lab bench targeting up to 98.4% peak conversion yield.
3. **Solid-State SiC Commutation**: Simulation model targeting < 2.4 ms bus transition handover without mechanical relay arcing.
4. **Safety & Standards Roadmap (Planned)**: Conceptual systems are designed to target Indian AIS-038 Rev 2, AIS-052, AIS-153, AIS-156, and UN ECE R100 frameworks; formal certification testing has not yet started or been obtained.

## Vehicle Concepts & Indicative Targets (Not Binding Quotations)
- **StarCraft GT**: Aerodynamic electric sedan CAD/CFD concept. Indicative target price ₹16,50,000. Modeled range target up to 850 km (simulated). Acceleration target 0–100 km/h in 3.2 s.
- **StarFleet**: Commercial electric delivery concept. Indicative target price ₹24,50,000.
- **StarTransit**: Urban transit 12M coach concept. Indicative target price ₹65,00,000.
*Disclaimer: Figures are simulated, bench-tested or target values at TRL 3/4. Real-world results will vary. Not a commitment of performance, delivery or price.*
